title: Clarify ls guidance when byte fitting hides the first matching item
outcome: The suggested show target is captured before byte fitting. If zero rows fit, the receipt suggests a ref absent from its items. Keep that useful navigation only with explicit first-match wording, or derive guidance from emitted rows.
acceptance: A zero-row byte-fitting regression verifies that guidance does not imply an unlisted row was shown and remains actionable within the response budget.

completion.summary: A zero-row byte-fitted receipt names the first matching ref explicitly in both structured hint and text, with actionable show guidance. The boundary test uses the real bounded projection with a smaller test budget; production remains at the protocol budget. Receipt fitting now lives in its owning receipts module.
